text:
Maya: Heads-up: EdgeNet alerted us to a planned egress throttle in eu-west2 (not a full outage) for 2026-04-01 03:00-03:40 UTC. They expect short TCP resets and prolonged tail latency on streaming requests.
Jun: Copy. Blast radius? just egress routers or NAT gateways too?
Maya: Provider says subset of egress peers and transient TCP RSTs on long-lived connections. Our streaming, embeddings uploads to external stores, and large context requests could see errors or stalls.
Leo: Can we shift new traffic to eu-west3 and switch streaming connections to chunked reconnects?
Priya: We can change routing policy to prefer eu-west3 for new connections and enable connection-level retry/backoff for streamers. Also suggest enabling model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model for latency-sensitive endpoints.
Jun: Ops playbook draft:
- 02:20 UTC: Pre-seed KV caches in eu-west3 for high-hit prefixes (payments, tokens, user-session).
- 02:35 UTC: Post status update + targeted email to tenants with pinned eu-west2 endpoints.
- 02:45 UTC: Start routing preference flip (10% -> 50% if metrics degrade).
- 03:00 UTC: Provider throttle active; monitor errors/stream resets
- 03:10 UTC: If stream resets > 3% sustained -> expand routing to 80% and enable model-fallback for streaming routes
- 03:40 UTC: Provider clears; validate health and roll back by 04:10 UTC.
Priya: Routing change (policy snippet):
```json
{
  "route_preference": ["eu-west3", "eu-west2"],
  "weight_overrides": {"eu-west3": 0.7, "eu-west2": 0.3},
  "ttl": 600
}
```
Jun: redwoodctl commands (dry-run first):
```bash
redwoodctl cache preseed --pool eu-west3 --prefix /kv/sessions --workers 10 --dry-run
redwoodctl routing set-preference --from eu-west2 --to eu-west3 --percent 10 --dry-run
redwoodctl pool cordon --pool eu-west2 --cohort streamer-canary
```
Sam: I'll extract the pinned-tenant list. Likely affected: payments, billing, and a few enterprise tenants with regional pins. DMing Anita the list.
Anita: Draft status message: "Were responding to a short network maintenance by our upstream provider affecting eu-west2 egress. We are routing traffic to a nearby region and monitoring. You may see brief transient errors or reconnects for streaming calls. ETA ~40m." Approve?
Leo: Approve. Cost note: moving heavy traffic to eu-west3 and extra retries will add roughly $650-950/hr. If we exceed 3 hours, escalate to finance.
infra-oncall: I'll own monitoring. Alert plan: stream_resets(eu-west2) > 2% for 5m -> page oncall; latency_p99(eu-west2) > 1s above baseline -> notify infra. If both tripped -> auto-expand routing.
ops-bot: Created maintenance ticket MN-4892 and attached runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary cohort reboot job queued for 02:50 UTC (manual confirm required).
Jun: Also check scheduled background jobs that perform external uploads (snapshot-upload, archive-sync, telemetry-forward). Pause noncritical ones for 03:00-04:15 UTC.
Maya: Good call. Jun please patch labels: --avoid-region=eu-west2 for those jobs.
Priya: Add connection-level resiliency for SDK stream clients: set max_reconnects=3 and jittered_backoff. We can flip this via runtime flag for streaming routes.
Sam: Noted. I'll coordinate with SDK team and queue the runtime flag for 02:40 UTC.
Anita: Sending tenant emails at 02:35 UTC. Status page update posted now.
Maya: Final checklist: pre-seed KV (Jun/Priya), routing preference flip (Jun), oncall monitoring (infra-oncall), customer comms (Anita), cost watch (Leo), SDK flag (Sam). Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
Leo: :+1:
infra-oncall: Alerts set. Will post updates at start/10/30/finish.
Maya: We'll test dry-run preseed at 02:05 UTC, execute real steps starting 02:20 UTC. Keeping this thread for live updates.
